attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "UserTimeZoneSelector now calls IUserTimeZoneService.GetAsync(currentUser) for every request, but GetAsync throws ArgumentNullException when currentUser is null (anonymous users), and the service also changes lifetime from Singleton to Scoped and removes/renames public methods, breaking any code directly injecting UserTimeZoneService."}

reason: UserTimeZoneSelector now calls IUserTimeZoneService.GetAsync(currentUser) for every request, but GetAsync throws ArgumentNullException when currentUser is null (anonymous users), and the service also changes lifetime from Singleton to Scoped and removes/renames public methods, breaking any code directly injecting UserTimeZoneService.
